findings.title: Reading thread is never joined before the assertion
findings.body: The test starts a background thread that repeatedly calls `managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(...)`, then immediately proceeds to delete the groups, set `deletedAll.set(true)`, and assert on `caughtExceptions` without ever joining the thread. Two race conditions make this unreliable: (1) the thread can be in the middle of a `groups()` call when `deletedAll` flips to true; it will complete that call, potentially catch an exception, and add it to `caughtExceptions` AFTER `assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty())` has already evaluated the list, so real NPEs are silently missed; (2) even if the thread exits before it, there is no happens-before edge between the thread's writes to `caughtExceptions` and the main thread's read (no join, no synchronization, no `volatile` semantics on the list beyond CopyOnWriteArrayList's internal ones), so the assertion is not guaranteed to observe the thread's writes. The test should capture the `Thread` reference, set `deletedAll.set(true)`, then call `thread.join()` before asserting.

findings.title: NPE guard added only to getSubGroupsCount; same null-supplier pattern still NPEs in other methods
findings.body: The fix changes `getSubGroupsCount()` to call `modelSupplier.get()` and return `null` if the underlying model is missing (group deleted after being cached). The same `modelSupplier` is used elsewhere in `GroupAdapter`, and those call sites will still throw NPE when a cached group is accessed after deletion: `getFirstAttribute` (line 149) calls `cached.getAttributes(keycloakSession, modelSupplier).getFirst(name)`; `getAttributeStream` (line 155) and `getAttributes` (line 163) call `cached.getAttributes(keycloakSession, modelSupplier)`; `hasDirectRole` (line 182) and `hasRole` (line 188) call `cached.getRoleMappings(keycloakSession, modelSupplier)`; `getRoleMappingsStream` (line 204) does the same; `getSubGroupsStream()` (line 240) calls `cached.getSubGroups(keycloakSession, modelSupplier)`; and the four-arg `getSubGroupsStream(...)` overloads (lines 256, 262, 268) call `modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` directly with no null check. `CachedGroup.getRoleMappings` only guards against a null supplier, not a null-resolved model, so the loader function `source -> source.getRoleMappingsStream()...` will NPE on a deleted group. Either the null-guard should be applied consistently (e.g., in `DefaultLazyLoader`/`CachedGroup` or by resolving once per method), or the test should be tightened so reviewers can see the full surface is covered.
